```{r load-packages, include=FALSE}
pacs <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "rentrez", "XML", "rcrossref")
sapply(pacs, require, character.only = TRUE)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) y else x

```

```{r fetch-pubmed}

# Read publication list ---------------------------------------------------

pub_list <- read_excel("oda_keiji_publications_doi.xlsx") %>%
  setNames(c("listid", "year", "authors", "pubmedid", "doi"))

# Split into: has a real PubMed ID  vs.  no PubMed ID (fetch by DOI instead)
pub_list_pmid <- pub_list %>%
  filter(!is.na(pubmedid), pubmedid != "N/A")

pub_list_doi_only <- pub_list %>%
  filter(is.na(pubmedid) | pubmedid == "N/A") %>%
  filter(!is.na(doi), doi != "N/A")   # can only look these up if a DOI exists


# Fetch from PubMed -------------------------------------------------------

records <- entrez_fetch(
  db      = "pubmed",
  id      = pub_list_pmid$pubmedid,
  rettype = "xml",
  parsed  = TRUE
)

abbreviate_forenames <- function(author_string) {
  authors <- strsplit(author_string, ", ")[[1]]
  abbreviated <- sapply(authors, function(a) {
    parts <- strsplit(a, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) < 2) return(a)
    last     <- parts[1]
    initials <- paste(substr(parts[-1], 1, 1), collapse = "")
    paste0(last, " ", initials)
  })
  paste(abbreviated, collapse = ", ")
}

safe <- function(x, fallback = NA_character_) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.null(x)) fallback else x[1]
}

articles <- xpathApply(records, "//PubmedArticle", function(node) {
  last    <- xpathSApply(node, ".//Author/LastName", xmlValue)
  fore    <- xpathSApply(node, ".//Author/ForeName", xmlValue)
  authors <- if (length(last) > 0) paste(paste(last, fore), collapse = ", ") else NA_character_
  doi     <- safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//ELocationID[@EIdType='doi']", xmlValue))

  if (is.na(doi)) {
    doi <- safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//ArticleId[@IdType='doi']", xmlValue))
  }

  data.frame(
    pmid    = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//PMID", xmlValue)),
    year    = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//PubDate/Year", xmlValue)),
    authors = authors,
    title   = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//ArticleTitle", xmlValue)),
    journal = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//Journal/Title", xmlValue)),
    volume  = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//JournalIssue/Volume", xmlValue)),
    issue   = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//JournalIssue/Issue", xmlValue)),
    pages   = safe(xpathSApply(node, ".//MedlinePgn", xmlValue)),
    doi     = doi,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

pubmed_df <- bind_rows(articles) %>%
  left_join(pub_list_pmid %>% select(listid, pubmedid),
            by = c("pmid" = "pubmedid")) %>%
  mutate(source = "PubMed")


# Fetch from Crossref -----------------------------------------------------

scalar_field <- function(df, field) {
  if (!field %in% names(df)) return(NA_character_)
  val <- tryCatch({
    x <- df[[field]]
    if (is.list(x)) x <- x[[1]]
    x[1]
  }, error = function(e) NA)
  if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) NA_character_ else as.character(val)
}

fetch_by_doi <- function(doi) {
  cr <- tryCatch(cr_works(dois = doi)$data, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(cr) || nrow(cr) == 0) {
    message("Crossref: no record found for DOI ", doi)
    return(data.frame(
      pmid = NA_character_, year = NA_character_, authors = NA_character_,
      title = NA_character_, journal = NA_character_, volume = NA_character_,
      issue = NA_character_, pages = NA_character_, doi = doi,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # Author list -> "Last Forename, Last Forename" (matches the PubMed format above)
  author_col <- if ("author" %in% names(cr)) cr$author[[1]] else NULL
  authors <- if (!is.null(author_col) && is.data.frame(author_col) && nrow(author_col) > 0) {
    paste(paste(author_col$family, author_col$given), collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }

  # Year can live under different fields depending on the record; try in order
  year <- scalar_field(cr, "published.print")
  if (is.na(year)) year <- scalar_field(cr, "published.online")
  if (is.na(year)) year <- scalar_field(cr, "published")
  if (is.na(year)) year <- scalar_field(cr, "issued")

  # Page range isn't always present -- fall back to Crossref's "article-number"
  # field, which many online-only journals use instead of a page range.
  pages <- scalar_field(cr, "page")
  if (is.na(pages)) pages <- scalar_field(cr, "article-number")

  data.frame(
    pmid    = NA_character_,
    year    = year,
    authors = authors,
    title   = scalar_field(cr, "title"),
    journal = scalar_field(cr, "container.title"),
    volume  = scalar_field(cr, "volume"),
    issue   = scalar_field(cr, "issue"),
    pages   = pages,
    doi     = scalar_field(cr, "doi") %||% doi,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

crossref_df <- map_df(pub_list_doi_only$doi, fetch_by_doi) %>%
  left_join(pub_list_doi_only %>% select(listid, doi), by = "doi") %>%
  mutate(source = "Crossref (DOI)")


# Combine both sources ----------------------------------------------------
pub_df <- bind_rows(pubmed_df, crossref_df) %>%
  arrange(listid)

```

```{r clean-data}

# Clean up ----------------------------------------------------------------

pub_df$authors <- sapply(pub_df$authors, abbreviate_forenames)
pub_df$authors <- gsub("Al AA", "Al Abdrabalnabi A", pub_df$authors)
pub_df$journal <- gsub("^[Tt]he\\s+", "", pub_df$journal)
pub_df$journal <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(pub_df$journal))
pub_df$journal <- gsub("Journal of Prevention \\(2022\\)", "Journal of Prevention", pub_df$journal)
pub_df$journal <- gsub("Bmc", "BMC", pub_df$journal)

# Manual correction
doi_corrections <- data.frame(
  pmid = c("23139343"),
  doi  = c("10.7556/jaoa.2012.112.11.726"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

pub_df <- pub_df %>%
  left_join(doi_corrections, by = "pmid", suffix = c("", "_manual")) %>%
  mutate(doi = ifelse(is.na(doi) & !is.na(doi_manual), doi_manual, doi)) %>%
  select(-doi_manual)

pub_df$journal <- gsub("\\s*:.*$", "", pub_df$journal)

```

```{r build-markdown, results='asis'}

# Build citations ---------------------------------------------------------

make_md_citation <- function(row) {
  row <- as.list(row)

  # Format volume/issue/pages
  volissue <- if (!is.na(row$volume)) row$volume else ""
  volissue <- if (!is.na(row$issue))  paste0(volissue, "(", row$issue, ")") else volissue
  pages    <- if (!is.na(row$pages))  paste0(":", row$pages) else ""

  # DOI or PubMed link (Markdown hyperlink)
  link <- if (!is.na(row$doi)) {
    sprintf("[[DOI]](https://doi.org/%s)", row$doi)
  } else {
    sprintf("[[PubMed]](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/%s/)", row$pmid)
  }

  # Bold my name 
  authors_md <- gsub("Oda K\\b", "**Oda K**", row$authors, perl = TRUE)

  sprintf(
    "%s (%s). *%s* **%s** %s%s %s",
    authors_md,
    row$year,
    row$title,
    row$journal,
    volissue,
    pages,
    link
  )
}

citations <- apply(pub_df, 1, make_md_citation)

# Descending count embedded in text (GFM ignores actual list numbers,
# so we use an unordered list and prepend the number manually)
n <- length(citations)
for (i in seq_along(citations)) {
  cat(sprintf("- [%d] %s\n\n", n - i + 1, citations[i]))
}
```
